titulo: B1 review and mock test: What you can do at B1

aula.objetivo: Take an honest stock of your level, practise reading, listening, writing and speaking in B1 format, and work through an original mock exam with an annotated answer key.

sessao.titulo: What you can do at B1

blocos.titulo: An honest list of what you can do at B1
blocos.explicacao: Read each line and answer honestly: I do it easily, I do it with effort, or I can't do it yet. For anything you can't do yet, go back to the lesson shown. This list is a Linvuu study tool, not an external assessment, and is only meant to help you find your way.

tabela.regra: narrate past events in sequence and with causes, using the preterite, imperfect, present perfect and pluperfect.
talk about the future, make guesses (future perfect) and say what would happen or would have happened (conditional and «si»).
use the subjunctive after wishes, doubt, emotion, time and purpose, and choose between present, perfect and imperfect.
pass on what someone said (reported speech), use «se» and the passive, gerunds and participles, and relative pronouns.
give your opinion, agree, disagree and use connectors politely.
write a formal email, talk about your CV and a job interview.
understand the gist of news, texts and clear conversations on everyday topics.
ask what's needed at the bank, for a phone line and for a rental, knowing that rules change and must be checked.
explain in other words, ask for repetition, check and buy time.
use the personal «a», verbs with prepositions, «por» and «para», and pronouns with infinitives, gerunds and commands.

blocos.enunciado: For each line on the list, talk for 30 seconds in Spanish giving a real example from your life. Mark the lines where you had to think hard and go back to those lessons before the mock exam.
Reread the tense maps from lesson 61 out loud and mark the topics where you still hesitate.
